allow_instructions: Shell commands that only run the repo test suite, a single test file, lint, typecheck, format-check, or skillsync tools under tools/ or .cursor/vendor/skillsync/tools/ (preflight-local, verify-tools, run-verification, re-break, validate-state, tdd-audit, render-pr-body, open-pr with --dry-run, security-audit --check-state) may run without asking.
yarn preflight, yarn preflight:full, yarn verify:tools, and yarn ss:* scripts that only run local checks may run without asking.

Read-only git commands (status, diff, log, show, rev-parse, branch, ls-files, check-ignore) and normal local git write commands (add, commit, checkout, switch, stash, pull, fetch) may run without asking when cwd is this repo.
Editing skills, commands, harness, rules, docs, and tools under this repo for the active task may proceed without asking.
Paseo MCP tools used to orchestrate agents in this workspace may run without asking.
Read-only GitNexus query/context/impact/detect_changes may run without asking when the repo is indexed.
block_instructions: Any command that reads or writes .env, credentials, secrets, or SSH keys must ask for approval.
git push --force, git reset --hard, and production deploys must ask for approval.
Installing global packages or changing Cursor/Paseo user config outside the repo must ask for approval.
git push to origin and gh pr create should ask unless the user explicitly asked to open or push a PR in this turn.
